description: a nervous man who hides under the bed during a thunderstorm, only to find something else already hiding there.
poem_text: When thunder cracked the night and shook the floor, | He hid beneath the springs, his pulse a roar, | A shiver, a hiss— | A stare from abyss— | A phantom smiled, its teeth like jagged shore.

description: a clumsy baker whose wedding cake collapses just before the guests arrive, but the happy mess becomes the most loved dessert of the night.
poem_text: A clumsy baker in wedding attire, | Set his tiered marvel to rise higher. | It tumbled, then sang, | A sweet, joyous clang, | Now guests cheer the crumble, their hearts on fire.
